Continue your adventure with a domestic flight to Aswan to board a luxurious 5-star Nile Cruise, sailing through the heart of ancient Egypt while visiting Philae Temple, Kom Ombo, Edfu, Karnak Temple, Luxor Temple, the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, and the Colossi of Memnon.

To complete your Easter experience, head into Egypt's magical Western Desert. Explore Bahariya Oasis, the Black Desert, Crystal Mountain, Agabat Valley, and the spectacular White Desert before spending an unforgettable night camping beneath a sky filled with stars. This Easter package is ideal for travelers looking to combine Egypt's greatest historical treasures with one of its most extraordinary natural adventures.
